record.what_it_does: MrScraper is an AI-powered web scraping platform that extracts structured data from websites via a dashboard, REST API, SDKs, CLI, or MCP server, with built-in proxies and anti-block handling.
record.auth_notes: All REST endpoints use a static per-account API token sent as the 'x-api-token' header (analytics endpoints instead take it as a query param 'apiTokenName'). The same token is used as a Bearer token for the MCP server's Authorization header. No OAuth2 flow is documented — tokens are generated manually from the dashboard, so a multi-user agent toolkit would need each user to paste in their own token.
record.access_notes: Free 'Scraper Free' plan gives 1,000 tokens/month with no credit card required; API token is available immediately from the dashboard after signup.
record.main_blocker: No OAuth2 — each user must manually generate and supply their own static API token

evidence.quote: The MrScraper API uses API token authentication to secure all endpoints.
Scraper Free includes 1,000 MrScraper tokens every month at no cost - no credit card required.
This cloud-hosted MCP server integrates directly with MrScraper, enabling secure, scalable scraping workflows without local setup
Built on REST principles, our API offers predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON-encoded request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses
Webhooks let you automatically send HTTP requests to another API when specific events happen in your scraper
